Open access in the journal market

Source: R/analysis.R
jn_oa.Rd

Counts works and open access works, and computes OA shares, for all journals or a dashboard portfolio, hybrid or fully open access, globally or for first-author countries. The same code runs on the Parquet export and on BigQuery (see jn_source()).

Usage

jn_oa(
  src = jn_source(),
  by = "pub_year",
  portfolio = NULL,
  agreement = NULL,
  agreement_period = TRUE,
  country = NULL,
  work_types = c("article", "review"),
  oa_model = NULL
)

jn_licenses(
  src = jn_source(),
  by = "pub_year",
  portfolio = NULL,
  agreement = NULL,
  agreement_period = TRUE,
  country = NULL,
  work_types = c("article", "review"),
  oa_model = NULL
)

jn_metadata(
  src = jn_source(),
  by = "pub_year",
  portfolio = NULL,
  agreement = NULL,
  agreement_period = TRUE,
  country = NULL,
  work_types = c("article", "review"),
  oa_model = NULL
)

Arguments

src

A jn_source(). Defaults to the Parquet files in parquet/.

by

Columns to group by: any of pub_year, issn_l, publisher, portfolio_id, agreement_id, oa_model, work_type, country_code.

portfolio

Portfolio IDs (see portfolios) to restrict to, or NULL for all journals.

agreement

ESAC IDs (see agreements) to restrict to the journals of these agreements, or NULL.

agreement_period

With agreement or "agreement_id" in by: if TRUE (default), count a journal's works only in the years in which the agreement ran (by publication year; agreements without a period are left out). If FALSE, count all years.

country

ISO-2 codes of first-author countries, or NULL for all works.

work_types

OpenAlex work types to include; NULL for all. The default counts research articles.

oa_model

NULL (default) for all journals, or "hybrid" and/or "full_oa" to restrict to these journals. Use by = "oa_model" to compare them. The OA model is taken per year: a journal that became fully OA in its OpenAlex oa_flip_year counts as hybrid up to and including that year, which is usually a transition year.

Value

A tibble with the by columns, articles, articles_oa, articles_oa_openalex, and the shares share_oa and share_oa_openalex. articles_oa counts every work in a fully OA journal-year and, in hybrid journal-years, works with a CC licence in Crossref; fully OA journals therefore have share_oa 1. How many works carry a CC licence in Crossref is in jn_metadata() (share_cc_license) and jn_licenses().

Details

Statistics per agreement are journal-level: all works in the journals an agreement covers, whoever the authors are. A journal covered by several agreements counts in each of them, so results by agreement_id must not be summed over agreements. Works matched to an agreement through their authors' institutions are in the agreement_journal_year table.

Journal and country totals follow the counting rules of the data model: without country, counts come from journal_year and every work counts once. With country, or "country_code" in by, they come from the country tables, where a work with first authors in several countries counts once per country (full counting).

jn_licenses() splits works by CC licence in Crossref (NA = no CC licence, which in a fully OA journal is a metadata gap, not closed access); share is relative to all works in the by group.

jn_metadata() reports how many works carry each kind of Crossref metadata, including a CC licence (share_cc_license). Shares are relative to articles_in_crossref.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Global trend of research articles, hybrid vs fully OA journals
jn_oa(by = c("pub_year", "oa_model"))

# Hybrid journals in the Wiley portfolio, German first authors, by licence
jn_licenses(portfolio = "wiley", country = "DE", oa_model = "hybrid")

# Top countries in 2025
jn_oa(by = "country_code") |> dplyr::filter(articles > 10000)

# OA in the journals of each Wiley agreement, during the agreement period
jn_oa(portfolio = "wiley", by = c("agreement_id", "pub_year"))
} # }
